content:
Sam: small stupid idea  celebrate model birthdays? pick a day, bring cake, and make a tiny persona card. whos in? :birthday:
Ivy: yes. I will bake a cake that says "Happy quantization day" and put tiny fondant GPUs on top. :cake:
Ken: what are we doing for the persona card? mine: "Falcon: naps in sunlight, answers curtly, steals your pen." :cat:
Rika: can we do an award for Most Likely to Hallucinate a Lifetime Achievement? trophy emoji pls. :trophy:
Sam: poll: react with :cake: if you want cake, :cookie: if you want cookies, :no_entry_sign: if you hate celebrations.
Ivy: also low-effort prompt contest idea: write a 2-line system prompt that makes a model write a 1-sentence birthday speech as if it were a tiny intern. winner gets a sticker.
Ken: example:
```
You are a junior office model giving a 1-sentence birthday toast. Keep it awkwardly sincere and mention stale coffee.
```
Rika: haha perfect. my entry: "I am a celebratory model; my main contribution is to cheer and misplace 4 staplers."
Sam: @lunchbot can we get a tiny paper banner printed that says "Happy Modelversary"?
lunchbot: Heads up  "Modelversary" mini event added to calendar. Catering: cake or cookies depending on votes. Budget owner: @PeopleOps.
Ivy: final logistics: who wants to man the sticker station? I can print designs: raccoon in a party hat, sleepy lab for Llama2, owl with a monocle.
Ken: volunteer list: Sam, Rika, Ken. Also please for the love of sleep don't name a host "raccoon-birthday". my pager cannot handle that. :sweat_smile:
